about_the_game:
What is "A Rayuela Game"?
"A Rayuela Game" is a game in which you throw a coin-like object called Tejo to a box that has a line in the middle, the player who gets closer to the line is the winner, it is just that simple.

What's different from a regular Rayuela game?
In a regular Rayuela game you can use only a certain type of Tejo but what if you could choose Tejos made of other materials and the boxes were also made of different materials. Wouldn't it be much more interesting?

At least the game would be more complex and it would be more interesting indeed... I guess.

In this DEMO you will be able to play two tournaments, the "Street Tournament" and the "Sawmill Tournament", in which wou will experience the game mechanincs of this game.

There are only three Tejos available in this DEMO and even though you could potentially buy also the boxes they are of no use because they are meant to be used freely only on Practice mode in the full game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 3700X (or equivalent)
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game has been tested and run under these specs but it should run on lower specs.
